name: Blocks Edit
description_en:
Blocks Edit is an HTML-first visual content editor for teams producing websites, landing pages, marketing emails, forms and documents from custom designs. Rather than supplying an application backend, it makes parts of an imported HTML theme editable through visual controls or CSS classes/HTML attributes. The output can go to external hosting or an email platform.

It is worth evaluating when a designer/developer wants to preserve approved structure while other people edit content and assemble reusable sections. The main operational decisions are theme preparation, permissions, propagation of theme changes, collaboration seats and separately charged integrations.
description_zh:
Blocks Edit 是面向团队的 HTML 优先可视化内容编辑器，可基于自定义设计生产网站、落地页、营销邮件、表单和文档。它不提供应用后端，而是通过可视化控制或 CSS 类/HTML 属性，使导入 HTML 主题的指定部分可编辑；输出可进入外部主机或邮件平台。

当设计师/开发者希望保留已批准结构，同时让其他人改内容、组合可复用区块时，可评估它。主要运营决策包括主题准备、权限、主题更新传播、协作席位及单独收费集成。

core_features.name_zh: 可编辑自定义 HTML 主题
core_features.explanation_en: Tag content, components, repeating regions and stackable sections in one HTML design, visually or in code.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在单个 HTML 设计中用可视化或代码标记内容、组件、重复区域和堆叠区块。

core_features.explanation_en: Paid collaboration adds roles, comments, review, revision history, quality checks and a shared library around the imported design.
core_features.explanation_zh: 付费协作为导入设计增加角色、评论、审阅、版本历史、质量检查和共享库。

core_features.explanation_en: Individual exported pages/emails omit editing tags; host/email/SSO integrations are separately priced rather than part of unlimited free editing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 逐页/邮件导出不含编辑标记，主机/邮件/SSO 集成独立定价，不包含在无限免费编辑中。

pricing.summary_zh: Solo 免费5GB；Collaborate $25/用户/月250GB，年付显示 $20/用户或五用户$99/月需核价。每项集成$10/用户/月，额外250GB $25/月，协作试用30天。

sections.title_en: Turn a design system into one importable theme
sections.title_zh: 将设计系统整理为可导入主题
sections.en: Prepare one HTML file with header/footer, sections between them, regions and standalone components, all with useful placeholder content. From the dashboard use New Theme to import HTML or a ZIP of assets up to 50MB. The guide requires files at the archive root without folders and does not support bundled font files; use font URLs with appropriate rights. The visual editor can add editable tags, or developers can add classes/attributes manually. Owner/admin permissions are required to upload/update themes. This is a defined theme-preparation task, not a promise that any existing site/application imports with all its behavior.
sections.zh: 应准备一个 HTML 文件，包含头尾、其间区块、区域和独立组件，并放入有用占位内容。在面板用 New Theme 导入 HTML 或最多 50MB 的资源 ZIP。指南要求文件放归档根目录、不使用文件夹，不支持打包字体文件，应使用有适用权利的字体 URL。可视化编辑器可添加编辑标记，也可由开发者手动添加类/属性；上传/更新主题需所有者或管理员权限。这是明确的主题整理任务，不承诺任意已有网站/应用保留全部行为导入。

sections.title_en: Keep authoring behavior separate from runtime behavior
sections.title_zh: 区分编辑行为与运行行为
sections.en: The theme hierarchy distinguishes inline text/images, reusable components, repeatable/removable regions and reorderable sections. In editing mode JavaScript is disabled, so carousels or other script-hidden content must degrade to accessible content for editing. Preview changes are not saved unless Save Content is used; that updates default placeholder content, including global header/footer text. Test a representative page and marketing email with realistic copy length, images and links. Review roles and quality checks on the collaboration plan rather than assuming the free solo editor includes team governance. No import, visual editing or email rendering was executed.
sections.zh: 主题层级区分行内文字/图片、可复用组件、可重复/删除区域及可重排区块。编辑模式禁用 JavaScript，因此轮播或脚本隐藏内容必须能降级为可访问编辑内容。预览修改只有执行 Save Content 才保存，并会更新默认占位内容，包括全局头尾文字。应使用真实长度文案、图片和链接测试代表页面及营销邮件，并在协作方案核对角色与质量检查，不能认为免费个人编辑器包含团队治理。本次未执行导入、可视化编辑或邮件渲染。

sections.title_en: Plan global theme updates differently for web and email
sections.title_zh: 分别规划网站和邮件主题更新
sections.en: The guide says theme changes rebuild affected web pages as well as related layouts/sections/components/pins. Email changes are not automatically applied: each email shows an update indicator so an in-progress campaign can opt in while archived emails retain their original state. Test a theme revision on a representative output before broad rollout and preserve a reviewed version for recovery. Individual page/email exports omit Blocks Edit template tags, but external scripts, forms, image URLs and sending-provider behavior still need validation at the destination. Browser extensions can alter saved code according to the guide, so inspect output if authoring tools inject UI.
sections.zh: 指南称主题修改会重建相关网页及布局/区块/组件/固定内容，邮件则不自动应用：每封显示更新标识，进行中的活动可选择更新，归档邮件保留原状态。广泛更新前应在代表输出上测试主题修订，并保留已审版本供恢复。逐页/邮件导出不含 Blocks Edit 标记，但外部脚本、表单、图片 URL 和发送商行为仍需在目的地验证。指南提醒浏览器扩展可能修改保存代码，若创作工具注入界面应检查输出。

sections.title_en: Count editors, integrations and shared storage
sections.title_zh: 计算编辑者、集成和共享存储
sections.en: Solo editing is advertised free with no editing limit and 5GB storage. Collaborate displays $25/user/month and 250GB, with a 30-day no-card trial and free review sharing. The yearly area separately displays $20/user and a five-user $99/month figure; confirm rounding, minimum selection, annual upfront amount and currency code at checkout. Asset hosts, email providers and SSO are $10/user/month each integration, so enabling FTP/S3/Marketing Cloud/SSO can materially change the bill. Extra 250GB is $25/month shared across the organization. Custom integrations require at least five team members on a yearly plan; educational/nonprofit discounts are advertised at25%. Pricing says no minimum contract and no cancellation penalty, not that integrations are free or all prepaid charges refundable.
sections.zh: 个人编辑宣传免费、编辑不限，含 5GB。Collaborate 显示 $25/用户/月、250GB，含 30 天免卡试用和免费分享审阅。年付区域另显示 $20/用户及五用户 $99/月，应在结账确认取整、最低选择、年付预收和币种代码。资源主机、邮件商和 SSO 每项集成另收 $10/用户/月，启用 FTP/S3/Marketing Cloud/SSO 会明显影响账单。额外每 250GB 为 $25/月，组织共享。定制集成要求至少五人年付团队，教育/非营利宣传25%优惠。页面无最低合同/取消罚款，不等于集成免费或全部预付款可退。

sections.title_en: Evaluate an editing layer rather than an application backend
sections.title_zh: 作为编辑层而非应用后端评估
sections.en: Blocks Edit can fit teams that already have approved HTML and need controlled content assembly across web/email channels. It is a less direct fit if the requirement is a complete database application, commerce engine, form-processing backend or automatic migration of arbitrary dynamic code. The homepage’s portable/static-output positioning does not establish a self-hosted editor entitlement or open-source license. Confirm export destinations, integration permissions, revision retention and a failed-publish recovery procedure for the selected setup. Marketing speed, quality and training claims were not measured. No connected host, SSO login, API operation, delivery or rollback was tested.
sections.zh: 已有批准 HTML、需要跨网页/邮件受控组装内容的团队可考虑 Blocks Edit。完整数据库应用、电商引擎、表单处理后端或任意动态代码自动迁移，并非由这些来源直接确立的适用任务。首页可迁移/静态输出描述不确立自托管编辑器权利或开源许可。应确认所选设置的导出目的地、集成权限、历史保留及发布失败恢复流程。营销速度、质量和培训描述未被测量，本次未测试连接主机、SSO 登录、API、投递或回滚。
